summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican printed the articles of agreement, signed December 4, 1868, for Tom Allen to fight Bill Davis for $1,000 a side on January 12, 1869, 40 to 60 miles from St. Louis. Allen was training near Cleveland.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican—St. Louis, December 18, 1868'. The current summary's '$1,600' and 'early 1866' come from the OCR errors.

facts.fact: Allen and William M. Davis signed articles of agreement to fight under the new rules of the English prize ring for $1,000 a side on January 12, 1869, at a place 40 to 60 miles from St. Louis; Bill Ryall signed on Allen's behalf
Allen was training for the Davis fight in the neighborhood of Cleveland, Ohio

notes: The paper calls Charles Gallagher 'a warm friend of Tom Allen'; Gallagher's own record is left out of the facts as it is not about Allen.
